title: One Has To...
grammar: Recap: ezért and mert; kell + infinitive with endings
goal: I can say why something happens with mert and what follows with ezért.
I can say what people have to do with kell and an ending like -nünk or -niük.
I can talk about waste and energy with four new words, such as műanyaghulladék.
I can say that we have to save water when there is little rain.
